items.name: dsh-memory
items.desc: White-box AGI architecture exploration: metacognition (self-cognition loop), continual learning (knowledge flywheel), world model (condition space, spatiotemporal memory graph), self-improvement (bootstrap discipline), zero-LLM white-box pipeline, and auditable trust guardrails.

items.name: dsh-j-space
items.desc: J-Space Cognition Suite SV1 native agent preset and standalone Cordis plugin: 13 modules, persistent controller and decoupled workspace.

items.name: dsh-prompt-polish
items.desc: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.

items.name: dsh-answer-reviewer
items.desc: Agentic answer reviewer for DeepSeek Harness: each final assistant turn is re-reviewed by a separate LLM graded 1-100; below-threshold scores steer the agent back with concrete feedback. The score is shown as a chip on the answer's action row (green pass / red needs-work, with retry count and reason on hover). Live gate config from the Reviewer 配置 tab in the conversation view ring above the composer (对话 / 轨迹 / 记忆系统 / Reviewer 配置), from a 127.0.0.1 HTTP server, or from an optional right-sidebar tab via dsh-better-sidebar.

items.name: dsh-quality-review
items.desc: Audit each finished assistant turn with an independent reviewer model and steer the agent to fix failed output, with at most 2 review rounds per turn and SOP-folder standards injected as an extra review dimension.

items.name: dsh-advisor-flow
items.desc: Executor/advisor workflow ported from pi-advisor-flow: the executor calls ask_advisor for a second opinion at key decisions, after repeated failures and before completion; equivalent repeated tool calls are intercepted before execution for an advisor review with a proceed/revise/blocked verdict, and hard mode force-reviews every turn before it closes. Per-call token and cost ledger with /advisor status readout, privacy tiers for repo context and file contents, six-shape secret redaction, and a web settings card; advisor failures never stall the main loop.

items.name: clearai-dsh
items.desc: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.

items.name: dsh-atn
items.desc: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.

items.name: dsh-outsourcing-expert
items.desc: Agent presets whose leader does no work itself: every non-management tool call is denied at the harness boundary so the task has to go to a subagent, after a one-time lookup of the available subagent models and a per-task model choice; a second preset deliberately picks the model least suited to the task.

items.name: deepseek-harness-game-studios
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness port of Claude Code Game Studios (CCGS v1.1.2, MIT): 76 skills, 49 agents, hook bridge.

items.name: dsh-cot-anchor
items.desc: Injects conclusions already established in the previous reasoning block after each tool result, so the model continues from them instead of re-deriving the same conclusions.

items.name: dsh-expert
items.desc: Expert roster for DeepSeek Harness: 636 experts across 22 divisions with full Chinese names and bios, summoned as subagents from the @ menu or by the model through list_t_experts / summon_t_expert / summon_t_experts, plus custom experts and a skill on/off switch.

items.name: dsh-proactive
items.desc: Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.

items.name: dsh-simulated-life
items.desc: Simulated life context for DeepSeek Harness: every turn injects the past 24h of simulated life events from the workspace .life/ directory (sliding-window filter, session-level deduplication with delta updates, world summary) as a collapsed context notice, and the life_react tool lets the agent record feelings, thoughts and actions back into its life log for the next round of world evolution — turning a DSH agent into a roleplay character with a persistent daily life.

items.name: dsh-gungnir#dsh-plugin
items.desc: Evidence-driven goal verification plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Locks goals via /ultragoal and verifies completion against command exit codes and generated artifacts, preventing the model from falsely reporting task completion.

items.name: dsh-heartbeat
items.desc: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.

items.name: dsh-engram
items.desc: Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with corridor topology, tour butler, and refurb list.

items.name: dsh-advisor-plugin
items.desc: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.

items.name: dsh-remote-control
items.desc: Let Agents directly control independent local DSH instances with zero intrusion—no plugins or components required on the target. Isolated environments enable autonomous configuration and testing, while Agents with different models and personalities can chat, role-play, or form nested control chains. Supports conversational setup, user-like operations, incremental reading, saved references, and remote session/workspace search.

items.name: dsh-pua
items.desc: Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.

items.name: dsh-switchman
items.desc: Turns the main model into a dispatcher: six pools (economy/mechanical/main/hard/vision/review) route each subtask to the right model, with ranking and per-route reasoning-effort pins. A context watermark (50k/90k/130k) nudges delegation early and, at the force level, forks a backup session, writes a handover doc, compacts, and continues without losing in-flight subagent work; /ctx-pause, /ctx-resume and /ctx-handover pause, resume or trigger the same machinery by hand. Optional Agent Teams mode adds persistent teammates and a shared task board; /vision lets text-only models handle images via the vision pool; tiered verification sends bigger diffs to a tester and an independent reviewer. Settings UI, READMEs and the conversation / code-comment / document language preferences all cover the same 11 languages (en, zh, zh-TW, ja, ko, de, es, fr, it, pt, ru); the plugin UI follows the DSH app locale unless forced otherwise. Bundles three skills: read-only MySQL/Redis verification, commit-message generation, and a requirements/design document convention.

items.name: muche-dsh-plugin
items.desc: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.

items.name: dsh-pua
items.desc: Fork of @michengai/dsh-pua that removes the upstream global kill-switch so the composer entry is always visible while the feature stays off by default and can be toggled per session; the entry is a dropdown (Turn on / Turn off / Options) with a more compact options panel.

items.name: dsh-host-rsi
items.desc: Reflective self-evolution plugin for local Qwen3.8 27B/3.8 Flash and online APIs: a coding-loop convergence steerer curbs Qwen3.8 27B/Flash repeated-verification deep-thinking to converge faster and cut thinking time; a five-state delivery guard detects and corrects stuck turns and infinite loops; model-agnostic host logic, mostly compatible with online APIs; per-use continual self-improvement with counter-reason self-checks, critic escalation, inverted-index memory retrieval, coding-loop convergence steering, and a five-state delivery guard.

items.name: orbital-agents
items.desc: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.

items.name: dsh-goalloop-agentteams
items.desc: Deterministic goal-completion gate for DSH: a contract-first AC grammar with named failable check commands, a gate that re-runs every check itself (zero model trust), verdicts bound to a tree digest so file changes void passing verdicts, and a hard deny on false completion at update_goal via tools/pre-execute with a false-complete counter that blocks after two catches; scope-aware task-level claim handling (strict or goal-only) keeps multi-task Agent Teams loops from deadlocking.

items.name: dsh-network-engineer
items.desc: Standalone Network Engineer Assistant agent preset plus a bundled 32-doc command knowledge base skill for DPtech, H3C, Huawei and Ruijie switches and routers: KB-first retrieval, cross-vendor command translation, topology and CLI-output screenshot reading, online manual lookup with cited sources, and mandatory risk annotations for dangerous commands; answers networking topics only.

items.name: dsh-dream
items.desc: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.

items.name: dsh-linghun
items.desc: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).

items.name: dsh-linghun-assembler
items.desc: Memory-assembly team for DeepSeek Harness: every message triggers a five-step cognition loop (judge, retrieve, assemble, feedback, calibrate) carried by role-playing subagents (judge, retriever, archivist, advocate, editor, scribe), using BM25 retrieval, time-ordered material, and LLM assembly to build useful material packs injected into linghun. Works with dsh-linghun.

items.name: portable-dsh-multi-agent-plugin
items.desc: Route each task to one model and its review to a different one, with qualification evidence, failover and a durable journal.

items.name: dsh-codex-peer
items.desc: Peer collaboration between a DeepSeek Harness agent and the local Codex CLI: split a goal into a shared work list, hand tasks over, review what comes back, and keep every prompt, event stream, and answer on disk.

items.name: dsh-loop-continue
items.desc: Resumes an agent turn that ended after narrating its next action without calling a tool: the guard replays the turn log on agent/turn-stopping, asks a judge model one true/false question, and steers the same turn to run one more step.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-claude-code-web
items.desc: Embeds Claude Code as a workbench in DSH, serving an in-host HTTP/WebSocket backend with a sidebar entry and a draggable overlay panel.
